answer: Social Matters >> Nikah (Marriage) Question ID: 25109 Country: India Title: My parents are looking for a match for me and they are about to finalise one, i have a doubt regarding this match if a shaikh's boy can marry a syed girl? please advice me in light of authentic Hadith & Quran. Question: Asalaamalia kum mufti saab! My parents are looking for a match for me and they are about to finalise one, i have a doubt regarding this match if a shaikh's boy can marry a syed girl? please advice me in light of authentic Hadith & Quran. Answer ID: 25109 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1777/1303/H=1431) If the parents of the girl agree, there is no harm in accepting the proposal and solemnizing the nikah. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
